role: Prospective CPU resource declaration for the guarded 51-cell initial temporal stage
first_cell_scope: One exact existing row from the declared 51; no extra case, changed force, retry or numerical setting
parallel_admission: Launch only this first row, require its independent completed-cell audit to pass, then admit at most eight concurrent workers
failure_policy: Stop new launches after any worker or first-cell audit failure; let independent in-flight workers finish; preserve outputs, statuses and queued rows without automatic retries
recovery_policy: An existing stage execution ledger or output requires inspecting the actual processes and evidence; never automatically restart
other_work: Retain unrelated machine processes; no GPU contexts or additional environments are started by this stage
monitoring: Record actual driver/worker PIDs, progress, wall time and completion artifact hashes; inspect host load/memory during execution and reduce new admissions if needed
qualification: Resource allocation only; no physical, numerical, prediction, uncertainty or policy qualification
